title: Finite quotient augmentation under normalized module and tower comparisons
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l, a scheme isomorphism g:X→Y, and an arbitrary unbounded completed-coefficient complex P on Y. Let F be sectionwise inverse image, L ordinary module pullback, η its adjunction unit, and ε the counit of the postcomposition/base-change site adjunction. Suppose b:L≅F satisfies b_M(η_M(V)(x))=M(ε_V)(x) on every pro-etale V and section x. Suppose a:(tower P)⋙F ≅ integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor g P is a tower isomorphism whose nth component is exactly QuotientTensor.insertion g n at the nth strict finite reduction of P. For every exponent n and cochain degree i, b_(P^i), followed by F of the quotient augmentation in degree i and a_n^i, equals ordinaryQuotientAugmentation(P)_n^i. Constructions are those of [def-fix-qcqs-completion-ordinary-models, def-pur-integral-derived-operations, def-trf-isomorphism-strict-quotient-models, lem-trf-quotient-tensor-insertion]. This is only a finite-level equality, with no Roos or completion conclusion.

source.place: Tags 03D2 and 03EL, specializing the adjunction and quotient insertion to expanded clause 4 of def-weil-frobenius-coefficient-twists.

proof.text: Use the ordinary module adjunction to test equality on its unit sections. The hypothesis on b converts its value into restriction along the site counit. Naturality of the quotient augmentation moves this restriction onto the reduced section.

Apply the insertion formula. Naturality of the finite pullback adjunction unit moves the remaining restriction through the finite generator. The right triangle of the site adjunction cancels the two restrictions; use PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply since restriction maps are semilinear.

The source quotient augmentation sends x to the unit tensor, and the ordinary quotient augmentation is uniquely normalized to its finite pullback generator. Their defining normalization equations finish the equality.

theorem isomorphismOrdinaryFiniteAugmentation
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E]
    [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (g : X ⟶ Y) [IsIso g]
    (b : ordinaryPull l E g ≅ inverseImageIntegralModules l E g)
    (hb :
    ∀ (M : integralTowerModules l E Y) (V : Y.ProEt) (x : M.val.obj (op V)),
      (b.hom.app M).val.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange g).obj V))
        (((ordinaryAdjunction l E g).unit.app M).val.app (op V) x) =
      M.val.map ((MorphismProperty.Over.mapPullbackAdj @WeaklyEtale ⊤ g
        (inferInstance : WeaklyEtale g) trivial).counit.app V).op x)
    (P : Cx l E Y none) (n : ℕ)
    (a : (tower l E Y none).obj P ⋙ trfInverseImageComplex l E g ≅
      (integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l E g).obj P)
    (ha : ∀ k : ℕ, a.hom.app (op k) = QuotientTensor.insertion l E g k
      ((unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E Y k).obj P)) (i : ℤ) :
    b.hom.app (P.X i) ≫ (inverseImageIntegralModules l E g).map
        ((((augmentation l E Y none).app P).app (op n)).f i) ≫
          (a.hom.app (op n)).f i =
      (((ordinaryQuotientAugmentation l E g).app P).app (op n)).f i
